artifacts.purpose: States that this repository is the private DATA companion of app-debloat and must stay private
Disables line-ending conversion so frozen evaluation files keep their hashed bytes

retention_rule.rule: Keep while frozen evaluation files are present.

artifacts.purpose: Step 0 design brief and per-lens research reports with sources
artifacts.schema: Markdown brief and JSON lens array
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Design decisions, documentation updates and later iterations

retention_rule.rule: Keep the latest brief and its lens reports; replace them when a new Step 0 brief supersedes them.

artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore from Git history or rerun the research workflow

artifacts.purpose: Evaluator-owned frozen acceptance policy, rubric, proof tasks and query sets
artifacts.schema: skill-smith acceptance policy schema 1 plus rubric and query JSON
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: acceptance_gate.py and the evaluator's G1 and G2 runs

retention_rule.rule: Never edit in place; a new policy gets a new pinned hash and replaces this one after review.

artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Not rebuildable; restore from Git history

artifacts.purpose: Raw G1 paired-run outputs, tool logs, G2 trigger trials, scores and the evidence manifest
artifacts.schema: Per-run output folders plus skill-smith evidence artifacts

retention_rule.rule: Keep the evidence bound to the accepted candidate and the latest attempt; remove superseded attempts once a newer candidate is accepted.

artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Rerun the evaluator against the same candidate and policy

artifacts.purpose: Real per-app evidence ledgers, inventory snapshots, triage output, plans, manifests, hooks and verification records
artifacts.producer: app-debloat runs on the owner's machines
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: The owner, later re-runs after app upgrades, and public per-app repos (scripts and docs only)

retention_rule.rule: Keep the current ledger, plan, manifest and the latest before/after snapshots per app; drop older snapshot pairs when a new verification passes.

artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Rerun inventory and the pipeline on the machine; ledgers are restored from Git history
